swamp.name: SWAMP
swamp.floor: broad flat traversable muddy-brown and muted moss-gray clearing, shallow puddles and flat leaf litter; no deep water within walking field
swamp.border: reeds, mangrove roots and water ONLY at the extreme outermost 4% edges
swamp.rear: small weathered timber swamp research shack with amber windows

desert.name: DESERT MILITARY BASE
desert.floor: broad flat warm tan packed-dirt and concrete military hardstand, faded runway markings and tire tracks
desert.border: very narrow cactus and military perimeter fragments only at outermost4% edges
desert.rear: low sand-colored military maintenance hangar with green steel doors

snow.name: SNOWFIELD
snow.floor: broad flat packed-snow clearing, subdued blue-gray ice patches and footprints; even readable terrain
snow.border: snowy pine fragments and low snow banks only at outermost4% edges
snow.rear: weathered wooden alpine shelter with warm lit windows and snow on roof

tech.name: TECHNOLOGICAL CITY
tech.floor: broad uninterrupted dark blue-gray paved industrial avenue, flush cable channels, tiny cyan power traces, worn yellow hazard floor paint
tech.border: narrow neon-lit industrial facade fragments ONLY at outermost4% edges
tech.rear: low electronics workshop/control building with cyan windows and amber lamps

lab.name: ABANDONED LABORATORY
lab.floor: broad continuous desaturated gray-green laboratory tile floor, flush drainage lines, scuffs and small flat paper scraps; no equipment in walking field
lab.border: cutaway steel/glass lab wall fragments ONLY at outermost4% edges
lab.rear: low containment control-room cutaway structure with dim green/amber monitors, no readable text

launch.name: ROCKET LAUNCH FACILITY
launch.floor: broad flat gray concrete launch-apron surface, faded runway lane markings, dusty oil stains and flush service covers
launch.border: tiny clipped orange gantry/support details only at outermost4% edges
launch.rear: low launch control bunker with warm amber windows and orange steel door

station.name: ORBITAL STATION
station.floor: broad continuous dark steel space-station floor deck, detailed flush panel seams and small pale-blue guide lights; traversable solid floor everywhere
station.border: thin station hull rim at outermost4% edges with outer space/stars beyond the rim, never holes within field
station.rear: low armored airlock/control module with pale cyan windows and pressure door

moon.name: LUNAR OUTPOST
moon.floor: broad flat muted gray lunar regolith plain, small shallow crater marks, dust tracks and fine mineral texture; no large rocks or pits within walking field
moon.border: tiny clipped rock ridges only at outermost4% edges, dark lunar horizon at very top
moon.rear: low gray lunar habitat module with airlock, small solar equipment outside the safe-rear doorway and warm lit windows

mars.name: MARTIAN OUTPOST
mars.floor: broad flat muted rusty-red packed regolith, flat cracks and rover tracks, fine stone texture; no large rocks within walking field
mars.border: clipped small rock ridges at outermost4% edges and dusty distant martian horizon
mars.rear: low ivory/orange Mars habitat shelter with warm amber windows and dust-covered panels

hive.name: ALIEN HIVE
hive.floor: broad uninterrupted flat dark violet organic chitin floor, subtle flat ribbed texture, muted green veins, no raised spikes or roots within walking field
hive.border: very narrow alien hive wall fragments at outermost4% edges with faint green luminescence
hive.rear: low fortified human expedition shelter built against the organic hive wall, steel door and small amber windows
